title: Crystal of the Elder Things
wikitext:
[[Image:CrystalOfTheElderThings.png|right|160px]]
'''Crystal of the Elder Things''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Any Phase''': Place 1 [[Sanity token]] from the [[bank]] on Crystal of the Elder Things to avoid paying the entire [[Sanity]] cost of a [[spell]] you are casting.  If there are 3 Sanity tokens on it, discard Crystal of the Elder Things.

'''Price''': $4
